nodes.label: Avaris Transparent Cinema Camera Cutout
nodes.rationale: Hero foreground extracted from the approved Avaris reference: a professional black cinema camera rig shown at three-quarter view with a large square matte box, raised top flap, lens, upper monitor, top handle, rails/follow-focus hardware, fluid head and tripod legs cropped at the bottom edge. Composition is a roughly square 1254x1254 canvas, tightly framed with a small transparent margin; the monitor top and matte-box tips are retained while the tripod legs run off the lower edge. Background treatment is true alpha transparency: transparent corners, no floor, haze, text, logo, checkerboard or cast shadow, with about half the canvas empty. Lighting is the original restrained dark cinematic look with black materials and subtle cool/red accents, not relit or redesigned. Design role: a compositable, replaceable hero layer placed over the separate studio plate and swappable for the 3D GLB scene later.
